name: blog-brief
description: Create a content brief for ONE planned post: target and secondary keywords, search intent, template choice, competitor gaps from the live SERP, sourced statistics to include, section plan, internal-link targets, and distribution ideas. Use when the user says "content brief", "blog brief", "SEO brief", "article brief". Not a skeleton only (blog-outline), a multi-post plan (blog-strategy, blog-calendar, blog-cluster), or the article itself (blog-write).
